The '''Assault Armor Division''' was a command of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] that was responsible for the control of the [[Army/Legends|Army's]] heavy vehicular support, such as heavy [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] like the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]], and repulsor vehicles and tanks. It was one of the important organizational distinctions of the Imperial Army.

While at the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]], [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] decided to join the Assault Armor Division in order to operate the AT-AT walker, which he believed best personified his personality as well as that of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>

The [[3rd Imperial Heavy Armor]] was a part of the Assault Armor Division. It fought the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] multiple times during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="VotF" />
